messages.author: 44e88d964e317aa3
messages.subject: Re: Error to remove soil
parts:
Hi 
Instead of using HUE index for removing soil you could try with a Plant index like GLI or NGRDI cropvalue should probably be around 0,03 if using GLI but you can try with different values
DAA1.RemSoil <- fieldMask(mosaic = DAA1, Red = 1, Green = 2, Blue = 3, index = "NGRDI", cropValue = 0.00, cropAbove = F)
